app = FastAPI(title="Reservas de salas", lifespan=lifespan)
app.include_router(routes_auth.router)
app.include_router(routes_reservas.router)

import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass

import pyotp
from fastapi import Header

from app.config import USERS


class AuthError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Session:
    token: str
    username: str


_sessions: dict[str, Session] = {}


def verificar_otp(username: str, code: str) -> bool:
    """Comprueba un código TOTP (RFC 6238) para `username` con tolerancia de ±1 paso de 30s."""
    user = USERS.get(username)
    if user is None or not code:
        return False
    totp = pyotp.TOTP(user["otp_secret"])
    return totp.verify(code, valid_window=1)


def otp_header(x_otp: str = Header(default="")) -> str:
    """Dependencia de FastAPI que lee la cabecera X-OTP.

    Regla general: todo endpoint HTTP que autentique con usuario y contraseña
    exige además el OTP. En POST /login viaja como campo `otp` del body; en
    cualquier otro endpoint viaja en la cabecera X-OTP, leída con esta dependencia.
    """
    return x_otp


def login(username: str, password: str, otp: str) -> Session:
    """Valida credenciales y OTP, y abre una sesión. Lanza AuthError si no son válidos."""
    user = USERS.get(username)
    if user is None or not secrets.compare_digest(user["password"], password):
        raise AuthError("credenciales invalidas")
    if not otp or not app_verificar_otp(username, otp):
        raise AuthError("otp invalido")
    session = Session(token=secrets.token_urlsafe(24), username=username)
    _sessions[session.token] = session

import pyotp
import pytest

from app.auth import AuthError, get_session, login
from app.config import USERS
from tests.conftest import otp_now


def test_login_correcto_abre_sesion():
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", otp_now("alice"))
    assert s.username == "alice"
    assert get_session(s.token) == s


def test_login_password_incorrecto():
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "mal", otp_now("alice"))
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("nadie", "alice-pass", otp_now("alice"))


def test_login_otp_incorrecto_o_vacio():
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass", "000000")
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass", "")


def test_login_sin_otp_falla():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass")


def test_login_acepta_tolerancia_de_un_paso(monkeypatch):
    totp = pyotp.TOTP(USERS["alice"]["otp_secret"])
    codigo_pasado = totp.at(totp.timecode(__import__("time").time()) * 30 - 30)
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", codigo_pasado)
    assert s.username == "alice"


def test_verificar_otp_se_puede_sustituir(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.auth.verificar_otp", lambda username, code: True)
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", "cualquier-cosa")
    assert s.username == "alice"


def test_endpoint_login(client):
    body = {"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass", "otp": otp_now("bob")}
    assert client.post("/login", json=body).status_code == 200
    assert client.post("/login", json={**body, "password": "x"}).status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/login", json={**body, "otp": "000000"}).status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/login", json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass"}).status_code == 401
